Blocked cross-validation of a calibrated model

Source: R/calibrate.R
cross_validate_model.Rd

For each fold, calibrates on "train" days and scores both train and test. Folds are independent, so they can run in parallel: forked processes (parallel::mclapply) on macOS/Linux; on Windows, future.apply under the user's future::plan() if installed, otherwise serially.

Usage

cross_validate_model(model_fn, bounds, obs, folds, n_cores = 1, seed = 1, ...)

Arguments

model_fn, bounds, obs

As for calibrate_model(): parameters -> simulated flow, param_bounds(), observed flow.

folds

Output of make_blocked_folds() (dates must match obs).

n_cores

Folds run at once.

seed

Base seed; fold f uses seed + f, so results don't depend on n_cores.

...

Passed to calibrate_model().

Value

list(metrics = tibble per fold x set, params = tibble per fold, sims = long tibble of out-of-fold test simulations, traces = tibble of best-so-far objective per evaluation and fold)
